e.summary: **Delayed-Retirement Incentives in Spain**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.22798797`，版本 `1.0.0`）**是一份**把**「**延迟退休**激励**」**与**「**精算中性**」**做**成**可**重跑**包的**西班牙**养老金**复现**工件****——**⭐ 逐字标题为**「**Replication package for Delayed-Retirement Incentives in Spain: Lump-Sum Commutation and Actuarial Neutrality**」**。**本次实测**：**⭐ 发布日 **2026-09-16****（**窗口内）**、**类型逐字 **`software`****、**作者逐字 **`Ación López, Ahmed` 与 **`Vidal-Meliá, Carlos`****、**文件**逐字**为 **`Delayed_Retirement_Spain_Replication_v1.0.0.zip`（**34,677,348 B）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**跨仓储元数据聚合面**」**，**并**补上**本站**最薄的一栏之一**——**人寿保险**（**实测**本轮**之前 **25** 条）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **它**把**「**精算中性**」**当**成**可**复算**的**命题****——**⭐ 逐字**「**It reproduces the actuarial valuations, alternative discounting specifications, fiscal and policy-risk exercises, weighted summaries and terminal-age sensitivities reported in the manuscript dated 16 September 2026.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**延迟**退休**到底**划不划算**」**在**这里**不**是**观点**，**而**是**一组**可**用**冻结**输入**重**跑**的**估值**；**② ⭐⭐ 它**把**不**能**公开**的**部分**逐字**写在**描述**里**（**⭐ 逐字**：**「**Individual administrative microdata, their original extraction program and the denominator for the reported 7.96% incidence are outside the package.**」**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**最值得**学**：**⭐ 即**「**复现**包**」**的**诚实**标准**不是**「**全都**给**你」**，**而**是**「**说**清**哪**一层**给**了、**哪**一层**没有**」**；**⭐ 它**还**逐字**把**复现**起点**写明**（**「**supplied mortality vectors and 125 aggregate MCVL cells**」）**，**读者**可以**据此**判断**自己**能**走到**哪**一步**；**③ **许可**分**两**层**（**MIT** 管**代码、**CC BY 4.0** 管**文档**与**结果）**，**并**逐字**提示**第三方**材料**仍**按**原**提供方**条款**；**④ **交付**里**同时**有 **R** 模型**与**独立 **Python** 校验**——**⭐ 即**「**用**另**一种**实现**互**相**验**证**」**，**而**不**是**同**一套**代码**跑**两**遍**。**⚠️ 本次**未下载**其 **zip**、**未重跑**其**估值**。
e.body:
**Delayed-Retirement Incentives in Spain**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.22798797`，版本 `1.0.0`）**是一份**把**「**延迟退休**激励**」**与**「**精算中性**」**做**成**可**重跑**包的**西班牙**养老金**复现**工件****——**逐字标题**为**「**Replication package for Delayed-Retirement Incentives in Spain: Lump-Sum Commutation and Actuarial Neutrality**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**跨仓储元数据聚合面**」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-20 Zenodo 记录接口实测）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**把**「**精算中性**」**当**成**可**复算**的**命题**，**而**不**是**观点****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**It reproduces the actuarial valuations, alternative discounting specifications, fiscal and policy-risk exercises, weighted summaries and terminal-age sensitivities reported in the manuscript dated 16 September 2026.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**「**一次性**折算**与**延迟**领取**谁**更**划算**」**在**寿险**与**年金**语境里**是**常**被**口语化**的**问题**，**而**这**份**包**把**它**拆**成**可**复算**的**几**组**（**估值**、**折现**口径**、**财政**与**政策**风险**情形**、**加权**汇总**、**终**龄**敏感性）**——**⭐ 对**写**养老金**作业**的人**，**这**是**一个**可**照抄**的**「**把**结论**拆**成**可**重跑**部件**」**的**样板**。
**⭐⭐ ② ⭐⭐ 它**把**不**能**公开**的**部分**逐字**写**在**描述**里**，**并**写明**复现**起点****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**Replication begins with supplied mortality vectors and 125 aggregate MCVL cells. Individual administrative microdata, their original extraction program and the denominator for the reported 7.96% incidence are outside the package. Historical development scripts, generated caches and internal preparation notes are excluded.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是**本条**最值得**学**的**：**⭐ 即**「**复现**包**」**的**诚实**标准**不**是**「**全都**给**你」**，**而**是**三**件**事**：**说清**起点**（**从**什么**输入**开始**能**跑**）**、**说清**边界**（**哪**一层**不**在**包**内）**、**说清**排除**了**什么**（**历史**脚本**与**内部**草稿**）**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**交**课程**项目**时**，**把**「**别人**拿到**这个**包**能**不能**重**跑出**我**的**数**」**写**成**一**句**，**通**常**比**多**交**三**个**文件**更**有**说服**力**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**个体**行政**微观**数据**不**在**包**内」**是**数据**保护**的**正常**结果**，**不**是**缺陷**，**但**它**意味**着**那 **7.96%** 的**发生率**在**包**外**无**法**独**立**复**算**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 许可**分**两**层**，**并**交代**第三方**材料****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**Licence scope: MIT applies to the authors’ original R and Python code. CC BY 4.0 applies to the authors’ original documentation and computational results. Supplied inputs and third-party materials retain their source-provider terms and attribution, as detailed in LICENSE.md and docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.**」**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**一**个**包**里**同时**有**「**我**写**的**代码」**、**「**我**出**的**结果」**与**「**别人**给**的**输入」**时**，**许可**要**按**层**标注**（**⭐ 这**与**第 **378** 轮**记下的**「**软件**与**数据**许可**可能**不同」**同向）**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**引用**复现**包**时**，**先**看 **`LICENSE.md`** 与**数据**来源**清单**是否**分开**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 交付**同时**含 **R** 模型**与**独立 **Python** 校验**工具****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**列**出 **`the portable R model`** 与 **`independent Python validation tools`****；**⭐ 本词条**认为**：**⭐ 即**「**用**另**一种**语言**的**独立**实现**互**相**验证**」**与**「**同一**套**代码**跑**两**遍**」**是**两**件**不同**的**事**，**前者**才**能**抓**到**实现**层**的**错误**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**定价**或**准备金**作业**时**，**哪怕**只**用**一**个 **Excel** 表**复算**关键**数字**，**也**比**同**一个**脚本**跑**第**二**遍**有**价值**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 其它**可**核实**信息**与**窗口****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**发布日 **2026-09-16****（**窗口内）**、**类型逐字 **`software`****、**版本逐字 **`1.0.0`****、**文件**逐字 **`Delayed_Retirement_Spain_Replication_v1.0.0.zip`（**34,677,348 B）**、**作者逐字 **`Ación López, Ahmed` 与 **`Vidal-Meliá, Carlos`****；**⭐ 描述**逐字**声明**「**This research output is independent of the manuscript’s journal review process.**」**，**并**说明**后续**变更**会**以**新**版本**发布**以**保留**每个**可**复现**发布**的**确切**文件**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**独立**于**期刊**评审」**与**「**随**版本**冻结**文件」**是**两**条**可**核对**的**承诺**（**⭐ 本词条**未**核实**其**后续**是否**真的**这样**做）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[longevity-risk-r]] 覆盖**长寿**风险**的 **R** 模拟**、**[[lifecontingencies]] 覆盖**寿险**精算**计算**、**[[reproducible-actuarial-work]] 覆盖**精算**可**复现**工作**的**做法**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**以**国家**行政**数据**的**汇总**权重**与**冻结**死亡率**做**养老金**精算**中性**复现**」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **把**结论**拆**成**可**重跑**的**部件**；**② **复现**包**要**写清**起点、**边界**与**排除**项**；**③ **许可**按**层**标注**；**④ **用**独立**实现**互**验**；**⑤ **「**独立**于**评审」**与**「**版本**冻结」**是**可**核对**的**承诺**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载**其 **zip**（**34,677,348 B）**、**未**安装 **R** 或 **Python** 环境**、**未**重跑**其**任何**估值**，**故**不**主张**其**可**复现**性**、**数值**正确性**或**代码**质量**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**Zenodo 记录接口返回的**元数据与描述**，**未读**其 **`LICENSE.md`**、**`docs/DATA_SOURCES.md`** 或**任何**脚本**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**所**引 **INE** 预测**下载**与 **MCVL 2024** 汇总**权重**的**来源**与**授权**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与**论文**的**对应**关系**（**本次**只**见**描述**自述**与**论文**日期 **2026-09-16）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**「**7.96%** 发生率**」**的**口径**（**⭐ 分母**逐字**说明**不**在**包**内**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**后续**版本**是否**真的**冻结**文件**。**⑦ ⚠️ 窗口**状况**：**发布日 **2026-09-16** 在**本轮**窗口**之内**（**基准日 **2026-09-20）**，**故**无需**缺口**说明**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-20 所见**；**⚠️ 涉及**养老金**与**折算**政策**，**⚠️ 不**构成**任何**国家**的**政策**或**税务**建议**。

e.summary_en: This is a replication package for delayed-retirement incentives and actuarial neutrality in Spain, described in writing as containing a portable model in one language, independent validation tools in another, frozen mortality inputs, original projection downloads, aggregate composition weights, regenerated results, and the tables and figures of a manuscript dated the same month. **Measured this round**: published on the sixteenth of September inside the window, typed as software, credited to two named authors, and shipped as a single archive of about thirty-three megabytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of cross-repository metadata aggregators and fills one of the thinnest categories on the site, life insurance, which held twenty-five entries before this round.** **Four things are worth reading: it turns actuarial neutrality into a recomputable proposition, stating that it reproduces the actuarial valuations, alternative discounting specifications, fiscal and policy-risk exercises, weighted summaries, and terminal-age sensitivities of the manuscript, so whether delaying retirement pays is not an opinion here but a set of valuations that can be rerun from frozen inputs; it states in writing what cannot be shared, namely that individual administrative microdata, the original extraction program, and the denominator behind a reported incidence rate are outside the package, and it also names the starting point of replication as supplied mortality vectors and a stated number of aggregate cells, which is the honest standard for a replication package, since the point is not to hand over everything but to say which layer is included and which is not; the licence is split, with one licence covering the authors original code and another covering their documentation and computational results, and third-party material is noted as retaining its provider terms; and the delivery pairs a model in one language with independent validation tools in another, which cross-checks two implementations rather than running one implementation twice.** **No archive was downloaded and no valuation was rerun this round.**

e.body_en:
This is a replication package for delayed-retirement incentives and actuarial neutrality in Spain. **This entry belongs to the round theme of cross-repository metadata aggregators.**
**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-20 from the record interface**:
**First, it turns actuarial neutrality into a recomputable proposition rather than an opinion.** The description states in writing that the package reproduces the actuarial valuations, alternative discounting specifications, fiscal and policy-risk exercises, weighted summaries, and terminal-age sensitivities reported in a manuscript dated the sixteenth of September. **Whether lump-sum commutation beats deferral is a question usually discussed in prose in life and annuity settings, and this package breaks it into recomputable parts, which makes it a template for splitting a conclusion into rerunnable components. For coursework on pensions, that is the transferable move.**
**Second, it states in writing what cannot be shared and names where replication starts.** The description says that replication begins with supplied mortality vectors and a stated number of aggregate cells, that individual administrative microdata, their original extraction program, and the denominator behind a reported incidence rate are outside the package, and that historical development scripts, generated caches, and internal preparation notes are excluded. **The honest standard for a replication package is therefore three statements: where replication starts, which layer is absent, and what was excluded. When handing in coursework, one sentence about whether someone else can rerun your numbers usually persuades more than three extra files. Microdata being withheld is a normal consequence of data protection rather than a defect, but it does mean the reported incidence rate cannot be independently recomputed from the package alone.**
**Third, the licence is split by layer and third-party material is accounted for.** One licence covers the authors original code in two languages, another covers their documentation and computational results, and supplied inputs and third-party materials are stated to retain their provider terms, with separate files documenting sources. **When a package contains your code, your results, and someone else input, label the licences layer by layer, and check whether the licence and data-source files are separate before citing.**
**Fourth, the delivery pairs a portable model with independent validation tools in another language.** Using an independent implementation in a second language to cross-check is a different thing from running one implementation twice, and only the former catches implementation-level errors. **Even recomputing key figures in a spreadsheet is worth more than a second run of the same script.**
**Fifth, other verified facts and the window status.** It was published on the sixteenth of September inside the window, typed as software at version one, shipped as a single archive of about thirty-three megabytes, and credited to two named authors. **The description also states that the research output is independent of the manuscript journal review process and that later changes will be released as new versions preserving the exact files behind each reproducible release, which are two checkable commitments, though this entry did not verify that later versions actually freeze the files.**
**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover long-run mortality simulation in one language, life-contingency calculation libraries, and reproducible actuarial practice, **while this entry supplies the form of a pension actuarial-neutrality replication package built on aggregate administrative weights and frozen mortality inputs. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: split a conclusion into rerunnable parts; state the starting point, the boundary, and the exclusions of a replication package; label licences by layer; cross-check with an independent implementation; and treat independence from review and version freezing as checkable commitments.**
**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no archive was downloaded, no environment was installed, and no valuation was rerun**, so no claim is made about reproducibility, numerical correctness, or code quality. **Second, only metadata and description were read**, not the licence file, the data-sources document, or any script. **Third, the provenance and authorisation of the projection downloads and aggregate weights were not verified. Fourth, the correspondence between the package and the manuscript was not verified. Fifth, the basis of the reported incidence rate was not verified**, the description stating that its denominator is outside the package. **Sixth, whether later versions actually freeze files was not verified. Seventh, the publication date falls inside this round window against a baseline of the twentieth of September. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on that date and states plainly that it constitutes no policy or tax advice for any country.**
